name: 1Password
description: Sign in to websites with saved logins and one-time codes from your 1Password vaults, through the 1Password CLI and a read-only service account.

setupFields.label: Service account token
setupFields.helpText: Read-only service account token from 1Password.com → Developer → Service Accounts.

installationSteps: On 1Password.com, open Developer → Service Accounts and create a service account with read-only access to the vaults to share. Built-in Personal, Private, and Employee vaults cannot be shared with service accounts.
Add this plugin and paste the service account token. Every Bot can then sign in to websites with matching saved logins and one-time codes.
Replace the token here after rotating it. Uninstalling removes the token from OpenTeam; revoke the service account at 1Password to end access there.

skills.name: 1password
skills.description: Sign in to websites with the user's saved 1Password logins and one-time codes. Use whenever a site asks for a username, password, or verification code.
